item.title: Naveen Patnaik demands Odisha Health Minister’s resignation Over SCB fire; Assembly deadlock continues
item.description: Bhubaneswar: Amid the ongoing deadlock in the Odisha Assembly, Leader of Opposition (LoP) and Biju Janata Dal (BJD) President, Naveen Patnaik, on Tuesday reiterated his party’s demand for the immediate resignation of State Health Minister, Dr Mukesh Mahaling over the fire at the Trauma Care ICU of SCB Medical College and Hospital, in which at least 12 patients lost their lives and several others sustained serious burn injuries. item.title: No opinion or exit polls during key phases: ECI warns ahead of elections
item.description: Chennai: The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Tuesday announced a comprehensive ban on the conduct, publication, or dissemination of Exit Polls during the ongoing Assembly election cycle. As per the schedule, polling in Assam, Kerala and Puducherry will be held on April 9, while Tamil Nadu will vote on April 23. West Bengal will go to the polls in two phases on April 23 and April 29. item.title: Two LPG ships carrying 92,600 tonnes of LPG en route to India from Hormuz: Govt
item.description: New Delhi: The government on Tuesday said that two LPG carriers, Pine Gas and Jag Vasant, have safely crossed the Strait of Hormuz and are on their way to India. Rajesh Kumar Sinha, Special Secretary, Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, said during an inter-ministerial briefing that the Pine Gas vessel will arrive at New Mangalore port on March 27, which carries 45,000 metric tonnes of LPG. “Jag Vasant will arrive at Kandla port on March 26, carrying 47,600 metric tonnes of LPG. item.title: Harish Rana, first Indian permitted passive euthanasia, dies at AIIMS Delhi after 13 years in coma
item.description: New Delhi: Harish Rana, the first person in India to be granted permission for passive euthanasia, passed away on Tuesday at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, after remaining in a coma for more than 13 years. The 31-year-old, who had been in a permanent vegetative state since 2013 following a severe head injury, was shifted from his Ghaziabad residence to the palliative care unit at the Dr B.R. item.description: Tehran: Mohammad Baqer Zolqadr has been appointed as the new Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, replacing Ali Larijani who was killed in an Israeli attack last week, the Iranian media reported on Tuesday quoting a statement issued by Mehdi Tabatabai, the Iranian President's Public Relations aide. item.title: Court sentences man to 7-year RI for sexual assault of divyang minor in Boudh
item.description: Boudh: After convicting a man for sexually assaulting a divyang (differently abled) minor girl in 2024, a court in Boudh district today awarded him a seven-year rigorous imprisonment. An Additional District Judge in Boudh convicted Ganesh Pradhan of Gudapada village, who was found guilty under Section 10 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act and Section 332(g) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. item.description: Bhubaneswar: During a high-level review meeting held today here, Minister for Housing and Urban Development, Krushna Chandra Mahapatra directed all Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) to establish fully functional 24x7 control rooms with dedicated helpline numbers to assist the public during the upcoming summer heatwave. item.title: Odisha disburses ₹208.35 crore interest subvention to over 2.67 lakh SHGs
item.description: Bhubaneswar: During a programme organised in Bhubaneswar today, ₹208.35 crore was disbursed as interest subvention to 2,67,131 Self-Help Groups (SHGs) across Odisha against their bank loans. In the financial year 2025–26, a total of ₹724.39 crore has been reimbursed as interest subvention to 3,80,763 SHGs, further strengthening women-led financial inclusion initiatives. item.title: Elderly couple killed in alleged assault by son in Sundargarh
item.description: Lephripada (Sundargarh): In a shocking incident, an elderly couple was allegedly beaten to death by their son in Sundargarh district. item.title: Bhubaneswar civic body wins award for renewable water infrastructure, sludge treatment innovation
item.description: Bhubaneswar: The Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation (BMC) has won the Global Sustainability and Innovation Awards 2026 for its excellence in climate-resilient renewable water infrastructure and innovative sludge treatment practices. The award was presented at a function in New Delhi organised by the Earth Water Foundation.
